import inspect
from solution import max_sum_increasing_subseq


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example asserts max_sum_increasing_subseq([1,101,2,3,100,4,5],7,4,6)==11."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([1, 101, 2, 3, 100, 4, 5], 7, 4, 6) == 11  # 1+2+3+5 = 11


def test_issue_fully_increasing_prefix():
    """Maximum sum of increasing subsequence from prefix till ith index including kth element."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 5, 3, 4) == 15  # 1+2+3+4+5 = 15


def test_issue_ignores_elements_between_index_and_k():
    """Maximum sum uses prefix till ith index, not elements between index and k."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([1, 2, 100, 3, 4], 5, 1, 4) == 7  # 1+2+4 = 7


def test_issue_k_smaller_than_all_prefix():
    """Maximum sum including kth element is just kth element when nothing precedes it."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([5, 6, 7, 2], 4, 2, 3) == 2  # just 2


def test_issue_single_element_prefix_increasing():
    """Prefix till ith index with one element smaller than kth element is included."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([10, 20], 2, 0, 1) == 30  # 10+20 = 30


def test_issue_single_element_prefix_decreasing():
    """Prefix till ith index with one element larger than kth element is excluded."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([20, 10], 2, 0, 1) == 10  # just 10


def test_issue_skips_large_prefix_element():
    """Maximum sum skips prefix element larger than kth element."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([1, 100, 2, 3], 4, 2, 3) == 6  # 1+2+3 = 6


def test_issue_picks_max_sum_predecessor():
    """Maximum sum picks best predecessor subsequence from prefix."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([3, 1, 2, 4], 4, 2, 3) == 7  # 1+2+4 = 7


def test_issue_equal_values_not_combined():
    """Increasing subsequence requires strictly increasing values."""
    assert max_sum_increasing_subseq([2, 2, 3], 3, 1, 2) == 5  # 2+3 = 5


def test_contract_signature_has_four_params():
    """Public interface is max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, n, index, k)."""
    sig = inspect.signature(max_sum_increasing_subseq)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 4


def test_contract_does_not_mutate_input():
    """Public interface takes list a without breaking the caller by mutation."""
    a = [1, 101, 2, 3, 100, 4, 5]
    snapshot = list(a)
    max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, 7, 4, 6)
    assert a == snapshot


def test_contract_deterministic_result():
    """Public interface max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, n, index, k) is deterministic."""
    a = [1, 101, 2, 3, 100, 4, 5]
    r1 = max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, 7, 4, 6)
    r2 = max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, 7, 4, 6)
    assert r1 == r2
